entities.summary: Willem, Count Bentinck, Lord of Rhoon and Pendrecht was an Anglo-Dutch aristocrat and politician, the eldest son from the second marriage of William Bentinck, 1st Earl of Portland. He was created Count Bentinck of the Holy Roman Empire in 1732. Bentinck played a leading role in the Orangist revolution of 1747 in the Netherlands.
